# Leaflet 1.9.4

Vendored unchanged from the Leaflet 1.9.4 npm distribution via https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/ on 12 November 2026. Includes JavaScript, CSS and the five referenced images. See LICENSE for Leaflet's BSD license.

Local files remove the runtime CDN dependency. Basemap tiles still come from OpenStreetMap and require internet. The source-map reference in the upstream JavaScript is for developer tooling; it is not required to render the map.
